title: RubricAssessment
description: Per-student rubric assessment returned by the Canvas Submissions API with include[]=rubric_assessment&include[]=user.

sis_user_id.description: Institution SIS ID. Always present on the user object but may be null if not provisioned.

score.description: Top-level total rubric score for the submission. Null if not yet graded.

assessment_type.description: Source of the assessment. All three values are accepted.

rubric_assessment.description: Dictionary keyed by criterion ID. This key is absent entirely (not null) when the submission is ungraded — consumers must use .get('rubric_assessment') rather than direct access.

rating_id.description: ID of the selected rating on the rubric scale. Confirmed present in the submissions endpoint inline hash.

points.description: Points awarded for this criterion. Null if criterion not yet graded.

comments.description: Grader free-text comment. Always a string — empty string '' when no comment entered, never null.
